newsitem.title: UK: Ldn gold fixed just lower, platinum stays firm.
newsitem.headline: Ldn gold fixed just lower, platinum stays firm.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed just lower at $342.00 from $342.25. Trading in narrow range, but failure to regain $345.00 seen pushing market to lows.
PLATINUM - Stays above $380.00 with tight forward market.
Quoted unchanged at $380.50/$381.50. Market eyes Russia's moves.
PALLADIUM - Also unchanged at $156.00/$157.00, follows platinum.
SILVER - Just two cents up at $4.75/$4.77. Rangebound.
